title: Game deltas
description: Per-player and per-tile changes between two consecutive game states, recovered by diffing because the transport ships whole states and no patches. Client-side only.

d-money.description: next.money minus prev.money. Zero when there is no previous value.

d-vp.description: next.vp minus prev.vp. Zero when there is no previous value.

d-income-level.description: Change in income LEVEL, not in track spaces: a two-space advance may be worth one level or none.

income-level.description: Current income level from next. Exactly the money paid out at round end, so it sizes the payout animation without duplicating levelFromSpace.

per-player.description: One entry per player in next. A player absent from prev yields all-zero deltas, so joining mid-lobby does not animate a windfall.

id.description: The built-tile id, for looking the live tile up when the animation renders.

city.description: Board-location id to fly the piece to.

owner.description: Player id, resolved to a colour through the seat.

items.description: A deliberate three-field projection of built-tile, not the tile itself: everything else is read live at render time rather than carried stale in the diff.

new-tiles.description: Tiles in next.tiles whose id is absent from prev.tiles. Empty on the first render, so the opening snapshot never animates the whole board.

round-rolled.description: Inferred, not received: the round number or the era changed, and collectIncome runs in endOfRound just before that bump. False on the first render.
